messages.subject: methylKit 0.9.2 releases
messages.body_plain:
methylKit 0.9.2
--------------
IMPROVEMENTS AND BUG FIXES

* A bug introduced with 0.9.1 is fixed. The bug occured when unite() function
is used with destrand=TRUE argument. It returned less number of CpGs then it was
supposed to, although returned CpGs had correct methylation and coverage values. Contact  methylkit_...@googlegroups.com if the issue persists.
